Haemophilus Influenzae and Hepatitis B Vaccines Vacunas de Haemophilus influenzae y la hepatitis B. ATC — J07CA08. Adverse Effects and Precautions As for vaccines in general, p.2201. Interactions As for vaccines in general, p.2202. Uses and Administration Haemophilus influenzae type b (Hib) conjugate and hepatitis B vaccines are available in some countries for active immunisation as part of the primary immunisation of infants born to HBsAg- negative mothers. In the USA, an Haemophilus influenzae type b conjugate (meningococcal protein conjugate) and hepatitis B (recombinant) vaccine is used. It is given in a schedule of 3 dos- es, 0.5 mL being given intramuscularly at 2 months, 4 months, and 12 to 15 months of age.
